item.title: City Council Elects Jamie Dunphy as New President
item.description: Jeremiah Hayden by Jeremiah Hayden Technically, Portland City Council finally adjourned a meeting that began January 7 on January 14, after it elected Jamie Dunphy to serve as its president for 2026. Dunphy’s election came after some 13 hours of deliberation over three days stretched across a grueling week for Portland leaders and community members. item.title: Gus Van Sant's New Film Returns to His True Crime Roots
item.description: Al Pacino does not appear to ever stand up in this film. by Dom Sinacola Al Pacino does not stand up at any point in Dead Man’s Wire.
